'''Cliff "Doc" Christiansen''' was Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 66 in Omaha, Nebraska, from August 1999 to January 2001.<ref name="decsq-bespin" /> The slot is marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Christiansen played from the game's release, ran tournaments and gave seminars on deck construction in Omaha. He wrote three books for the ''Champions'' role-playing game.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
After I played in my first Star Wars tournament, I knew that I had found the perfect game for me.

I support the game by running tournaments, and I also conduct seminars on deck construction and game play methods.

I think Star Wars CCG is the best card game on the market. It makes you think of an overall strategy, like chess.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
